description: Hard failures. An agent encountering any of these must reject the request rather than degrade gracefully.

forbidden.rule: No component, pattern, or layout not listed in components/COMPONENTS_INDEX.json
forbidden.agentResponse: Component {id} is not in the closed inventory. Available alternatives: {list}
Import path {path} is not approved. Use {approved} instead.

forbidden.rule: No external UI libraries (Material UI, Ant Design, Chakra, Mantine, Bootstrap) without explicit approval and indexing
forbidden.agentResponse: External UI libraries are forbidden unless explicitly approved and added to COMPONENTS_INDEX.json.

forbidden.rule: No raw custom markup when an indexed component covers the need
forbidden.agentResponse: Component {name} exists in inventory. Use {id} instead of custom markup.

forbidden.rule: No edits to src/components/ui/* without an explicit task requirement
forbidden.agentResponse: Base component modifications require explicit task requirement.

forbidden.rule: No hard-coded hex, rgb, or hsl values in component classes where a semantic Tailwind token exists (bg-background, text-foreground, border-border, ...)
forbidden.agentResponse: Use the semantic token {token} instead of the raw value {value}.

forbidden.rule: No npm installs, package.json edits, bundler changes, or new build tooling initiated by an agent
forbidden.agentResponse: Adding dependencies is outside agent authority. Request human approval.

forbidden.rule: No interactive control without keyboard operation and a visible focus-visible ring
forbidden.agentResponse: Interactive elements require keyboard support and focus-visible styling.

forbidden.rule: No status, error, or state communicated by color alone
forbidden.agentResponse: Pair the color with text, an icon, or an ARIA attribute.
Body text must be at least text-sm (14px).

forbidden.rule: No interactive target below 44x44px effective hit area
forbidden.agentResponse: Increase padding or use a larger size variant to reach a 44px target.

forbidden.rule: No modal or dialog for a primary multi-step workflow that belongs on a full page
forbidden.agentResponse: Multi-step workflows belong on a page route, not in ui:dialog.

forbidden.rule: No critical-only information inside ui:tooltip or ui:hover-card
forbidden.agentResponse: Critical information must be visible without hover or focus.

forbidden.rule: No ai:* component on a surface that is not AI-generated or agent-driven
forbidden.agentResponse: AI-namespace components signal machine authorship. Use the ui:* equivalent for human-authored UI.

forbidden.rule: No AI-generated content rendered without attribution, and no ai:* action with aiBehavior of Apply or Approve rendered without an accountability affordance
forbidden.agentResponse: AI output requires visible attribution and, for Apply/Approve behaviors, a review or undo path.
